justification: Both surfaces present a broad upright pillar face bearing a profile quadruped rendered in flat, low-relief outline with schematic legs and head, occupying the upper part of the shaft, which is a fairly specific shared scheme. However, A is densely populated with a whole stacked programme, a row of crouching creatures across the top, a banded register, a bird-headed profile creature, small figures, a plant-like or feathered motif and a long-necked bird below, whereas B shows a single isolated animal on an otherwise blank face.
